values.note: Central bathhouses with hot showers; laundromat open Memorial Day to Labor Day; two dump stations; camp store. Over half a mile of river shoreline with a beach.

facilities.source: https://www.fiverivercampground.com/ ('centrally located bathhouses offer unlimited hot showers and modern restrooms', 'a Laundromat (open Memorial Day to Labor Day) and two convenient dumping stations', 'over 1/2 mile of natural shoreline'; Camp Store page in the site menu), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book online through the campground's Bonfire booking page ('CLICK HERE TO VIEW CAMP MAP & BOOK NOW'). Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children; $5 per extra person per day; early check-in or late check-out $20. Cancellation: $5 a night if at least 72 hours out, else one night plus $5 a night. Sites not guaranteed. During the Pickin' in Parsons bluegrass festival (late July - early August) camping is only for festival ticket holders.

booking.source: https://www.fiverivercampground.com/ (rates, check-in/out, additional guests, cancellation) + https://www.fiverivercampground.com/rules--regulations.html ('Reservations can be made by clicking on the book now button') + https://www.fiverivercampground.com/rules.html ('Each person occupying a campsite must have a valid festival ticket ... Camping is available only to festival attendees beginning July 25'), read 2026-10-21

note: Private campground on the Shavers Fork in the Cheat River watershed at Parsons; Sites 225, 227, and 230 are listed as waterfront. --Claude
summary: Confirmed fees $30-$55 (2 adults + 2 children) as recorded. Added season April 1 - October 31, 20/30/50-amp service on 190 full-service sites, showers/laundry/two dump stations/camp store, Bonfire online booking and its terms. Note: dropped '$50/night' (wrong: the operator says $30-$55; fees hold it). Not stated: water/sewer at the site spelled out, max rig length, pull-throughs.
flags: Rates undated: the homepage says 'rates starting at $30 to $55 per night' with no year, though the page is current (it announces showers reopening May 17th 2027 and links a 2026 flier). Bonfire (the booking engine) is a captcha engine and was not automated. Base $30 is under the US$50 gate; family has not stayed here.

Festival takeover: during Pickin' in Parsons (camping 'available only to festival attendees beginning July 25', through early August) the campground is festival-only, and its 'Wait list for Full Service Camping' page is for that festival, not a seasonal-site wait list. No sign of seasonal/annual sites otherwise.
